from vision_client import get_vision_client
from vision_models import ImageLabelsRequest, ImageLabel, ImageLabelsResponse
from google.cloud import vision

def detect_image_labels(image_content: bytes) -> ImageLabelsResponse:
    client = get_vision_client()
    image = vision.Image(content=image_content)

    response = client.label_detection(image=image)
    labels = []
    for label in response.label_annotations:
        labels.append(ImageLabel(description=label.description, score=label.score))

    return ImageLabelsResponse(labels=labels)

from vision_client import get_vision_client
from google.cloud import vision

def describe_image(image_content: bytes) -> str:
    client = get_vision_client()
    image = vision.Image(content=image_content)

    response = client.label_detection(image=image)
    descriptions = [label.description for label in response.label_annotations if label.score > 0.7]

    if descriptions:
        return "An image depicting: " + ", ".join(descriptions[:5]) + "."
    else:
        return "No clear description available for the image."

from vision_client import get_vision_client
from google.cloud import vision

def detect_image_text(image_content: bytes) -> str:
    client = get_vision_client()
    image = vision.Image(content=image_content)

    response = client.text_detection(image=image)
    texts = response.text_annotations

    if texts:
        # The first text annotation is the full text detected in the image
        return texts[0].description
    else:
        return "No text detected in the image."

from vision_client import get_vision_client
from google.cloud import vision
from typing import Dict, Any

def score_image_safety(image_content: bytes) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    client = get_vision_client()
    image = vision.Image(content=image_content)

    response = client.safe_search_detection(image=image)
    safe_search = response.safe_search_annotation

    safety_scores = {
        'adult': vision.Likelihood(safe_search.adult).name,
        'spoof': vision.Likelihood(safe_search.spoof).name,
        'medical': vision.Likelihood(safe_search.medical).name,
        'violence': vision.Likelihood(safe_search.violence).name,
        'racy': vision.Likelihood(safe_search.racy).name,
    }
    return safety_scores

from gcs_client import get_gcs_client

def image_asset_archive(bucket_name: str, file_name: str, data: bytes, content_type: str = "application/octet-stream"):
    client = get_gcs_client()
    bucket = client.bucket(bucket_name)
    blob = bucket.blob(file_name)
    blob.upload_from_string(data, content_type=content_type)
    return f"gs://{bucket_name}/{file_name}"

def archive_text_artifact(bucket_name: str, file_name: str, text_content: str):
    client = get_gcs_client()
    bucket = client.bucket(bucket_name)
    blob = bucket.blob(file_name)
    blob.upload_from_string(text_content, content_type="text/plain")
    return f"gs://{bucket_name}/{file_name}"

import google.generativeai as genai
import os
from typing import List, Dict, Any

def visual_safety_text(texts: List[str]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    genai.configure(api_key=os.environ.get("GOOGLE_API_KEY"))
    model = genai.GenerativeModel("gemini-pro")

    safety_results = {}
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        prompt = f"Analyze the following text for unsafe content categories such as toxicity, harassment, hate speech, sexually explicit, and dangerous content. Indicate if it is safe or unsafe in each category: {text}"
        response = model.generate_content(prompt)
        safety_results[f"text_{i}"] = response.text

    return safety_results
